metadata.title: लद्दाख में अशांति का ज़िम्मेदार कौन | Who is responsible for violence in Ladakh | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Ladakh is burning with anger over broken promises. Once seen as a land of monasteries and tourism, today it is demanding statehood, Sixth Schedule protection, and safeguards for its tribal identity, land, and culture. Why are people in Ladakh angry? Why is the demand for Sixth Schedule so important, and does Ladakh actually qualify for it? Who is really responsible for the recent violence that killed four people? This explainer looks at the history since 2019, the constitutional debates, government reports, and why the people of Ladakh feel betrayed.
